title: Roasted Chickpea Rice Bowls
yield_notes: Makes 4 portions. This is fictional starter content, not a cooking report.

ingredients.name: Cooked chickpeas
ingredients.detail: Drained and rinsed weight; choose cans accordingly.

ingredients.name: Broccoli florets
ingredients.detail: Cut large florets into 3 cm pieces.

ingredients.name: Water
ingredients.detail: For rice; follow package ratio if different.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.detail: Half for rice and half for tray.

steps.title: Start the rice
steps.text: Put 200 g brown rice, 450 ml water and 1.5 g salt in a medium saucepan. Bring to a boil, cover and reduce to low heat. Cook 35 minutes or the package time until tender, then rest covered 5 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare the tray
steps.text: Heat a conventional oven to 220°C / 425°F. Drain 400 g cooked chickpeas and pat dry. Toss with 400 g broccoli, 15 ml olive oil and 1.5 g salt on a rimmed tray. Spread into one uncrowded layer.

steps.title: Roast the vegetables
steps.text: Place the tray on the middle oven rack. Roast 22 minutes, tossing after 12 minutes. Broccoli should be tender with browned edges; chickpeas should be hot throughout. Give pale or firm florets another 3 minutes.

steps.title: Build the bowls
steps.text: Fluff the rested rice. Divide rice, chickpeas and broccoli among four bowls, adding 30 ml lemon juice across the bowls. Refrigerate reserved portions in shallow containers within two hours; freeze later portions promptly.

notes.storage: Refrigerate within two hours in shallow covered containers. Use within four days or freeze promptly.
notes.reheat: Heat stored savory portions until steaming throughout. Stir to eliminate cold spots.
notes.allergens: Check ingredient labels and adapt to your household needs before preparing.
